facts.fact: The municipal page describes a roughly 42-metre white-stone medieval tower on Via dei Priori, probably built in the late thirteenth century and associated with the Oddi and Sciri families.
The restored route to the roof uses 232 steps. The municipality explicitly says the tower is not accessible to people with motor disabilities and identifies the Priori association as its manager.
The municipal opening-information block specifies booking for group visits. It does not establish a permanent daily drop-in timetable.
